name: @pie-project/server-web
description: The browser half of @pie-project/server: the runtime and the WebGPU engine as wasm, reached through `import { Server } from "@pie-project/server"` under a bundler.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/pie.mjs src/worker.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:./worker.mjs --external:fs --external:path --define:__PIE_WASM__='"./pie_browser_bg.wasm"' --log-level=warning --log-override:duplicate-object-key=silent && cp pkg/pie_browser_bg.wasm dist/
